name: temporal-runner
description: Turns a Shofer node into a Temporal activity worker (runner): registers to capability-tagged task queues, pulls agent jobs, and drives the co-located Shofer via ctx.agent.spawn — durable, distributed, resumable. See docs/temporal_plugin.md.
author: Shofer

taskQueue.description: Capability-tagged task queue this node pulls from (polling = pool membership).

activityName.description: The activity type this worker registers and executes by driving Shofer.

concurrency.description: maxConcurrentActivityExecutions — capacity + backpressure (1 = one agent task at a time).

natsUrl.description: Optional NATS url for live telemetry (agents.telemetry.<taskId>). Empty ⇒ telemetry disabled.

heartbeatMs.description: Activity heartbeat interval (ms) — liveness + cancellation delivery for long agent runs.
